newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania leu ends flat at 3,600/3,615 to dollar.
newsitem.headline: Romania leu ends flat at 3,600/3,615 to dollar.

text.p: Romania's leu closed flat at 3,600/15 to the dollar on Friday, the same as Thursday's level, and traders said they expected it to depreciate further in an interbank market depleted of hard currency.
"I see the leu at around 3,800 to the dollar by mid-December, having in mind its gradual slip over the past weeks," one operator said.
The leu's reference rate was 3,591 on Friday.
Traders said they did not expect the interbank market, affected by continuous shortages of hard currency and almost no trading in past months, to revive over the next month.
"Most big exporters are still unhappy with the present exchange rate of the leu. They hope for rates of over 4,000," one trader said.
At licensed money exchange shops the dollar was quoted ar around 4,900, close to an all-time low of 5,000 or more recorded earlier this month.
"I doubt the dollar will cross the 5,000 barrier and eventually go through the ceiling very soon," a trader said.
Traders said the money market was overliquid in lei, with one-week funds at around 41 percent.
